The '''Jrade District''' was an upscale sector of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in the years preceding the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The district also included [[Jrade Plaza]], the headquarters of the [[Spotts TradeChip Company]], and the [[Chancellery Walkway]], along which was the [[Finis Valorum Memorial]]. The sub-adult school [[PSAS-5128]] was located in the north of the District. A [[Unidentified gala fundraiser|gala fundraiser]] occurred here on [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] which also featured an intricately-crafted [[Kime Enanrum]]-original ice statue, although the gala ended up ruined when Representative [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] destroyed the statue by accident due to placing the tablecloth the statue was on into his cummerbund, as well as trying to catch tumbling [[Canapé/Legends|canapés]] he knocked off of a passing waiter.
